title: Custom Software Engineer
description:
**Project Role :** Custom Software Engineer  
**Project Role Description :** Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs.
  
**Must have skills :** Enterprise Architecture Framework  
**Good to have skills :** NA  
Minimum **7.5** year(s) of experience is required  
**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  
  
Summary:  
We are accelerating growth and value for our clients by combining creativity, technology, and data-driven intelligence. Within our Commerce and AI practice helps organizations design, build, and scale modern digital commerce ecosystems - embedding Generative AI and Agentic AI into commerce to enable real-time personalization, autonomous merchandising, and intelligent customer engagement at scale.
  
About the role.  
We are entering an exciting era of agentic commerce where AI agents, conversational interfaces, and intelligent systems are reshaping how people discover, evaluate, and buy online. We are looking for technically strong architects who can help design and deliver the systems that make this real - working at the intersection of enterprise commerce platforms and emerging agentic AI technologies.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  
Own the architecture and drive its implementation not just designing agentic commerce solutions, but ensuring they are built correctly, consistently, and to the standard defined. Accountable for what gets delivered, not just what gets designed.  
Translate architecture into working systems taking multi-agent patterns, RAG pipelines, LLM-powered applications, and orchestration designs through to production, ensuring engineering teams build what was architected and course-correcting when they don't.  
Be the technical authority across the full delivery lifecycle from integration design with enterprise platforms (OMS, PIM, CRM, payments, fulfilment) through to verifying that APIs, event-driven patterns, and agentic protocols are implemented correctly in code and configuration.  
Ensure the data and knowledge foundations are built right hands-on oversight of embedding pipelines, vector retrieval, semantic search, and product data structures, validating that what underpins agent intelligence is production-grade and commercially reliable.  
Hold delivery teams to architectural standards — reviewing code, validating technical decisions, and maintaining coherence across workstreams so that implementation drift doesn't erode the integrity of the solution.  
Make AI governance and observability real in the build ensuring audit logging, human-in-the-loop escalation points, and monitoring frameworks are implemented as designed, not deprioritized under delivery pressure.  
Bridge architecture and engineering with clients running working sessions that move from whiteboard to build, giving clients confidence that technical decisions are being executed with rigor.  
Build repeatable delivery capability turning implementation experience into reference patterns, accelerators, and standards that make the next delivery faster and better.  
  
Professional & Technical Skills:
  
Around 4 years of professional experience in technical architecture, solution engineering, or software engineering with meaningful delivery experience across enterprise platforms and a growing specialism in AI and agentic systems
  
Hands-on experience delivering on at least one major enterprise commerce platform such as Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe Commerce, Commerce tools, SAP Commerce, or a composable / MACH-aligned stack with a solid understanding of how these platforms integrate with surrounding enterprise systems
  
Demonstrable, hands-on experience with Generative AI and agentic AI systems including LLM-powered application design, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures, and at least one agentic AI framework (e.g. LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI)
  
Familiarity with emerging agentic commerce protocols such as MCP, A2A, or ACP and how they are being adopted to connect AI agents with enterprise commerce systems and product data
  
Working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) for AI deployment, including familiarity with cloud-native services and CI/CD-based delivery practices
  
Understanding of AI governance and responsible AI principles including observability, tracing, auditability, and how to build guardrails into production AI systems
  
  
Additional Information:
  
Hands-on experience with hyperscaler agentic platforms such as Google Vertex AI Agent Builder, AWS Bedrock Agents, or Azure AI Foundry — and how they are applied in commerce delivery contexts
  
Exposure to composable commerce architecture patterns including MACH principles, headless commerce, and API-first platform design and how these enable more flexible agentic AI integration
  
A 15 years full-time education is required.  
This position is based out of Pune location

title: Software Developer
description:
Job title: Software Developer

Location: Gobichettipalayam,Erode

Salary: based on interview

Type: Contractual

Experience: 1\-3 years

Job Summary:

Shastika Global Impex private limited is looking for a Software Developer

who can independently handle and manage our entire ERP system \- from

development to deployment and support.

Key Responsibilities:

ERP Development \& Management:

\- Fully handle ERP system \- development, customization, implementation \&

maintenance

\- Develop and modify ERP modules as per business requirements

\- Manage ERP database, backend logic, and front\-end interface

Technical Responsibilities:

\- Strong knowledge of any ERP tech stack (PHP / Python / .NET / Java) \+

MySQL / SQL Server

\- Handle ERP integrations with other tools / APIs

\- Fix bugs, optimize performance, and ensure ERP security

\- Create reports, dashboards, and automations in ERP

Business Support:

\- Understand requirements from all departments (Sales, Purchase, Accounts,

Inventory)

\- Ensure smooth daily operations of ERP without downtime

Requirements:

\- B.E / http://B.Tech / MCA / http://M.Sc IT background

SAP B1, ERPNext preferred)

\- Good knowledge of Coding, Database Management \& Server handling

\- Problem\-solving attitude and ability to work independently

Pay: ₹18,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
